subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw accept `/stream` as a shared core session command backed by `SessionEntry.streamingMode` and the additive `previewStreamingSessionOverride` channel capability after the account-aware status defect is fixed?
rationale: The implementation adds a new user-facing command, persisted session preference, and plugin capability surface; code review can identify the bug, but maintainers own the permanent product/API shape.

options.title: Accept After Repair
options.body: Keep the shared Telegram/Discord/Slack MVP and require the status path to match runtime account config before merge.

options.title: Narrow The Surface
options.body: Limit the command or capability to fewer bundled channels until the shared plugin contract is explicitly designed.

options.title: Pause The Feature
options.body: Close or park this PR and keep the linked feature request open for a maintainer-sponsored design.

recommendation.title: Accept After Repair
recommendation.body: Keep the shared Telegram/Discord/Slack MVP and require the status path to match runtime account config before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to the account config, plugin SDK, and session command surfaces affected by the product/API choice.
